name: Spirit of Savagery and Spirit of the Hunt mark the caster with a positive aura (#9916, #7795, #7559)
contract: The five Spirits are stance-bar toggles whose self effect is a DUMMY marker on the caster. Savagery 707775
(self effect 1) and Hunt 707763 (self effect 2) also carry SPELL_ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF for their enemy area auras,
so every effect was classed negative and the caster's marker was sent with AFLAG_NEGATIVE. Conflict, War and
Bloodshed, which lack that attribute and which players report as shown active, send a positive marker.
Expected: the caster's own Savagery and Hunt applications are positive, like War's.
